title: Registry Rewards Terms — Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry
content:
Registry rewards of the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry are amounts accrued for the registrant on guests' net purchases from the registry and not yet paid out as a Registry Reward Card; each registry keeps its own registry rewards balance. The figures named here are those of the registry type's registry rewards schedule.

**§1 Accrual.** Each guest gift linked to the registry accrues the registry type's registry rewards percent of its guest gift amount, rounded half up to the cent; a type whose registry rewards percent is 0 accrues nothing.
*Status: no longer in force. The accrual of registry rewards on guest gifts is governed by the current registry rewards accrual basis.*

**§2 Reversal.** When a linked gift is returned, by the guest or by the registrant, before the payout, its accrual is reversed in full. A return after the payout changes nothing.

**§3 Payout test.** On the event date plus the registry type's payout days, in calendar days, the registry is tested. The payout is made only when the registry is in completion or closed status, as the registry record shows. When the registry's net guest purchases are at least the type's minimum for any payout, the accrued balance is paid out once, capped at the type's maximum rewards paid out, as a Registry Reward Card in the registrant's name. Any accrued amount above the cap, and any balance that misses the minimum, is forfeited.

**§4 Cancellation.** A cancelled registry forfeits its accrued balance on the cancellation date.

**§5 Who pays out.** The payout is made by the registry system and is never advanced.

**Net guest purchases** are the guest gift amounts recorded on the registry from its creation date to the day the question is handled, counting only gifts whose purchase record is not in returned status and leaving out gift cards and sales tax.

### Payout outcomes

| Status on the payout date | Net guest purchases against the minimum | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| completion or closed | at least the minimum | accrued balance paid once, up to the cap; any excess forfeited |
| completion or closed | below the minimum | balance forfeited |

### Worked payout (hypothetical figures)

A registry type with a minimum of USD 250.00 and a cap of USD 500.00; on the payout date the registry is in completion status, net guest purchases are USD 9000.00 and the accrued balance is USD 640.00. A Registry Reward Card of USD 500.00 is issued in the registrant's name and USD 140.00 is forfeited. Had net guest purchases been USD 240.00, the whole balance would have been forfeited.

superseded_clauses: Each guest gift linked to the registry accrues the type's registry_rewards_pct of its registry_gift_purchase amount, rounded half up to the cent; a type whose registry_rewards_pct is 0 accrues nothing.
